description: Shopify Stocky shut down on August 31, 2026 and never provided a Supplier Directory export. Paste a historical Stocky Purchase Orders CSV export (or pass `demo_mode: true`) and this tool reconstructs every supplier profile: actual observed lead-time average and standard deviation from Created-to-Received timestamps, latest SKU unit cost, GCD-inferred carton pack sizes, historical minimum PO spend, and ready-to-use `supplier_rules` JSON for `build_supplier_purchase_orders`.

demo_mode.description: Test supplier reconstruction using the built-in Stocky PO CSV fixture.

stocky_po_csv.description: Raw CSV content from Stocky Purchase Orders export.

name: migrate_stocky_csv_snapshot
title: Recover Supplier Directory, Real Lead Times & MOQs from Stocky PO CSV
